full_name: Marcus Wicker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Fiction & Poetry Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow University of Memphis
bio: An associate professor of creative writing at the University of Memphis, Marcus Wicker is a poet from Ann Arbor, Michigan, whose work addresses the diverse experiences of Black Americans using hip hop, jazz, and the subversion of traditional poetic forms.
